summary: Iteration 60 verifies the new Aug-2026 ₹118 SUBSCRIPTION / free-tier flow end-to-end. BACKEND (5/5 tests passed, /app/backend/tests/test_iter60_subscription.py): POST /payment/skip-subscription flips subscription_skipped=true for an unpaid user (verified via /auth/me) and returns already_paid=true for a paid user without mutating state; POST /withdrawals returns 'Complete registration payment first' for a free-tier user and creates no transactions; PATCH /admin/users/{id} {registration_paid:true} on a free user sets registration_paid=true, registration_source=offline_cash, paid_at, admin_approved_only=true, commission_triggered=true, subscription_skipped=false, creates EXACTLY ONE registration_fee txn (amount=118, status=paid, source=offline_cash), creates NO referral_payout/direct_signup_credit/gst_collected rows, leaves sponsor wallet_balance + total_earned unchanged, is idempotent (2nd PATCH does NOT create another fee txn), and /admin/transactions/summary?type=registration_fee.by_source.offline_cash rose by exactly 1 count / ₹118. /admin/finance/net-worth.group_3_gst.registration_gst stayed unchanged (RAZORPAY-derived only) and master.net_worth still equals bank_tally_net + pending_collections − user_wallet_balance − pending_withdrawals − gst_payable (formula verified). /admin/users/source-counts returns unpaid ≥ 1 with our free-tier user present. FRONTEND (verified in the 390x844 web preview): registering a brand-new user via POST /api/auth/register and injecting the returned token into localStorage routed the user straight to /payment; the screen shows the SUBSCRIPTION eyebrow, ₹118 amount, 'Complete your registration with ₹118' hero copy, ALL 8 benefits (Instant 50% cashback, Real-time priority support, Zero ads, Better shopping experience, Our priority customer, Unlimited cashback, Withdraw to your bank, One payment lifetime free), the 'Pay ₹118' button AND the 'Continue without subscription' testID=skip-subscription button. Tapping skip → skip-cancel/skip-confirm confirm sheet appears → 'Continue free' lands on /shop and re-opening / lands on /shop (never /payment again). /wallet shows subscription-locked with 'Activate for ₹118' CTA; /dashboard hides the Total Earnings card and shows the purple 'Activate subscription · ₹118' subscribe-banner; /profile shows the same banner; tapping the banner navigates to /payment (verified via mouse.click at coords — force=true click on the TouchableOpacity did NOT fire, minor RN-Web quirk, works with real touch/mouse). Paid user freetier1@test.com: NO subscribe-banner anywhere, wallet renders normally, Total Earnings card renders on dashboard. Admin /admin/users: SourceTabs testIDs users-source-all/razorpay/upi_manual/offline_cash/unpaid present, 'No subscription' tab shows count 14 and after selecting only 'NO SUB' badges appear (no '₹118 PAID'). Admin user-edit slide for freetier1 renders the 'Paid status' pill (testID edit-paid-status) showing '₹118 PAID' plus the 'Admin Approved' switch and the disclaimer note. Regression: /admin/transactions?type=registration_fee still shows the source tabs + CSV button (verified visually — screenshot shows 'All 9 · RAZORPAY 3 · UPI MANUAL' tabs + CSV) and /admin/system-wallet renders with Group 3 GST rows (no red screen). rca_of_issue: No open bug this iteration. The originally reported user pain (new user stuck at /payment even after admin approval) is fully addressed by the new flow: (1) POST /payment/skip-subscription flips subscription_skipped=true so index.tsx routes the user to /shop on every subsequent launch; (2) PATCH /admin/users/{id} {registration_paid:true} now flips subscription_skipped=false + admin_approved_only=true + commission_triggered=true and records ₹118 as an offline_cash registration_fee txn with NO referral cascade and NO GST — so an admin marking a free user paid gives them full paid privileges without leaking money into the referral tree. Verified end-to-end via 5 backend pytest cases + 3 Playwright browser runs on the preview URL.
